rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for a member of a pastoral society who moves with herds and has no fixed home.

example.english: On the grasslands, a nomad follows the flock around looking for pasture.
example.traditional: 喺草原上，遊牧民會跟住羊群周圍搵水草。
example.jyutping: hai2 cou2 jyun4 soeng6 jau4 muk6 man4 wui5 gan1 zyu6 joeng4 kwan4 zau1 wai4 wan2 seoi2 cou2

rows.jyutping: geoi1 mou4 ding6 so2 ge3 jan4
rows.note: Use this when emphasizing that someone frequently changes residence or has no settled home, without implying herding.

example.english: I move house so often that I’m basically a nomad.
example.traditional: 我成日搬屋，直頭係個居無定所嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 bun1 uk1 zik6 tau4 hai6 go3 geoi1 mou4 ding6 so2 ge3 jan4
